description:
The Accounts object is a representation of the accounts associated with a party.
This object enables the retrieval of the party's accounts and supports various
operations related to those accounts.

## Real-Time Events

In addition to the REST endpoints, some resources in this API are also delivered
proactively over the platform's
[Real-Time Events](https://plumery.stoplight.io/docs/plumery-services/78bef701130ff-real-time-events)
connection - a single, session-authenticated connection your app opens once and
keeps listening on for live updates, instead of polling.

Events are thin: each carries just enough detail to identify what changed - an
id, the specific field - alongside some of the changed data itself. They are a
notification, not a guaranteed or replayable history: events published before a
connection is established are not delivered once it opens, so an app's initial
state should always come from the REST endpoint, with events used from that
point on as incremental "something changed" signals.

Whether the data included on the event is enough to act on directly, or whether
to re-fetch the full resource from the matching REST endpoint, is up to the
consuming app - re-fetching is a safe default recommendation where the current,
authoritative state matters, not a strict requirement.

### Events published by API

| Event                     | Reflects                                                                               | Related REST endpoint                                |
| :------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------- |
| `account-balance.updated` | A balance in `AccountDetails.balances` - see `AccountBalanceUpdatedEvent` in `Schemas` | `GET /api/v1/parties/{partyId}/accounts/{accountId}` |

### Field reference: `AccountBalanceUpdatedEvent`

| Event field     | Corresponds to                                           | Notes                                                                                          |
| :-------------- | :------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `accountId`     | `AccountDetails.accountId`                               | Identifies which account the update belongs to.                                                |
| `balanceType`   | `Balance.balanceType` (within `AccountDetails.balances`) | Identifies which specific balance changed - an account can hold several balance types at once. |
| `balanceAmount` | `Balance.balanceAmount`                                  | The refreshed amount at the time of the event.                                                 |

### Example

As it appears on the Real-Time Events connection:

```
event:account-balance.updated
data:{"type":"account-balance.updated","accountId":"e7acae46e819c19640919a6720b192cb","balanceType":"interimBooked","balanceAmount":{"currency":"EUR","amount":"20568.00"}}
```
